text:
marina: Heads-up: ACME disputed INV-2024-0042 — large Dedicated overage for us-west2 over the weekend (2024-04-02 to 2024-04-03). Overage line = $12,120 on top of $16,312 commit. They say a planned DR failover should have landed on reserved failover pool but was billed as on-demand. Dropping here to triage and decide credit policy.
invocer-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0042 generated for ACME Corp — total $28,432 (overage $12,120). Payment due in 30 days.
devin-bill: CS reports ACME ran a DR test. They claim routing misdirected to on-demand. Requesting full waiver. @sree can you confirm routing/labels?
sree: Quick audit shows allocations in us-west2 lacking the reserved nodepool label. Metering picks the nodepool tag at allocation. Example log: "ALLOCATE pod=acme-dr labels={region:us-west2,nodepool:unlabeled} -> ROUTE pool=on-demand". Looks like tag missing so reserved pool never matched.
sree: Root cause seems infra/config drift in our failover deployment pipeline. We can push a CI admission check + alerting to prevent this. Retroactive reattribution is manual work for Billing.
carmen-cs: ACME is a priority customer. They'll accept a compromise if we pair a credit with an engineering fix and written assurances about failover handling.
oliver-legal: Note: T&Cs constrain credits to platform SLA breaches. We must avoid admitting liability. If Finance offers goodwill credit, include a settlement clause: credit is full settlement and no admission of fault.
marina: Finance proposal: one-time goodwill credit = 50% of overage ($6,060) + waive burst charges for 2 months up to $3k/month. Total potential concession ~ $12k. This avoids setting a full-waiver precedent. Approve?
devin-bill: ACME told CS they'd sign if we provide the above plus a commit and timeline for tagging guardrails.
sree: Engineering can deliver tagging enforcement and a pre-deploy gate within 48 hours. I'll open INFRA-4821 and add an ops alert if allocations occur without nodepool labels. We can also output a usage attribution report for the disputed window to help Billing adjust records.
oliver-legal: OK to proceed with the proposed goodwill credit + waiver cap. I'll draft the settlement text and include the release language. CS to collect signature.
ben: Approved. Finance to issue credit memo pending signed settlement. Eng to confirm fix. Keep me posted if ACME escalates.
marina: I'll prepare the credit memo and queue manual adjustment. Leaving thread open until CS posts signed settlement and Billing posts the credit.
